title: Home practical guide and safety card: feel and sieve test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Soils and aquatic plants (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 27 (Home practical guide and safety card: feel and sieve test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 27: Sand, clay and loam. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To compare soils by feeling and sieving them
equipment: Two or three soil samples from different places
safety: Wear gloves; do not touch your face
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put each sample on its own plate and label it
Rub a little damp soil between your gloved fingers: gritty (sandy), smooth (silty) or sticky (clay)?
Shake each sample through the sieve over a plate
Look at what stays in the sieve

questions.a: A mixture of sand, clay and humus
options: A mixture of sand, clay and humus

questions.q: Big question: why does damp sand make a sandcastle?
questions.a: A little water sticks the grains together.
